limitations: The frozen benchmark is inconclusive and does not authorize a material-performance or qualification claim.
Replica loss cancels the affected request; it does not migrate in-flight state, hand off KV, or automatically create a successor.

The deliberate browser-offline cancellation window records cancellation_unconfirmed because the client cannot acknowledge a server terminal while disconnected; server-side cleanup remained independently proven.
The foreground physical route was intentionally stopped after evidence capture, so retained evidence is not current admission authority.
Physical model artifacts were pre-existing and prepositioned; no model substitution occurred and no download or network transfer over 1 GB was performed during this closure.
